claim: Constructing preference data at each reasoning step (rather than only at the final answer) preserves gradient signal for common prefix tokens in preference optimization.
falsifier: Train a model using stepwise preference pairs (as in CPO) and compare gradient norms for common prefix tokens against a model trained with sequence-level pairs (as in DPO); the claim predicts that stepwise construction yields larger gradients for prefix tokens.

conditions: reasoning chains are generated via tree search
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported CPO method and experimental conditions; transfer beyond DPO-style losses is unestablished.

title: Stepwise construction of preference for gradient magnitude for common
